business.name: REQUIRED — Business name as the agent should say it
business.industry: REQUIRED — e.g. dental office, plumbing company, hair salon
business.address: OPTIONAL — street address the agent can read to callers
services: REQUIRED — at least one service, e.g. cleanings

faqs.q: OPTIONAL — a question callers commonly ask
faqs.a: The answer the agent should give

voice.voice_id: OPTIONAL — Retell voice id, defaults to 11labs-Adrian
voice.greeting: OPTIONAL — first thing the agent says; defaults to 'Thank you for calling <name>. How can I help you today?'

actions.booking_link: OPTIONAL — https:// booking page (Calendly etc.); agent reads it to callers who want appointments
actions.transfer_number: OPTIONAL — E.164 number like +14155551234; enables transfer-to-human
actions.webhook_url: OPTIONAL — https:// Apps Script web app URL; logs every call to the client's Google Sheet

phone.area_code: OPTIONAL — 3-digit US area code for the purchased number, e.g. 415

llm_model: OPTIONAL — Retell LLM model override; omit to use Retell's default
